_comment: Copy to public/manifest.json and replace __APP_NAME__. __APP_NAME__: lowercase letters, digits and single spaces only (e.g. 'my app'); the wallet rejects any other protocol name; basket names are lowercased. Keep metanet and babbage groupPermissions identical (G-03); every level-2 protocol names a counterparty and the allowance stays small (G-04). The BRC-29 entry uses counterparty 'self': it is unsettled whether BSV Desktop treats 'self' as grouped; a level-2 entry without counterparty prompts once per peer. This _comment field may be deleted from the deployed manifest.
